qualification: local pinned-fixture correctness and production-admission evidence; not hardware, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

admission.boundedRule: Tier one admits only the exact five-byte, one-instruction fixture block at the measured second-instruction entry boundary with qword RSI memory and RAX index. The same bytes at an adjacent RIP decline.
admission.restartability: The existing production-qualified compare-exchange loop selects signed bit-string qwords, retries from the returned observed value, publishes CF only after success, and rolls back the block on callback failure.

verification.focusedGate: Both measured atomic memory-BTS tests pass.
verification.dbtAndPCGate: 1,459 tests in 171 suites passed; the pinned PVH environment test skipped because its environment variables were absent.
verification.differentialCoverage: The standalone boundary matches the interpreter for signed indices 0, 64, and -1 with both old-bit states, exact CF, full architectural state, and memory.
verification.sharedEmitterCoverage: The reused emitter is separately covered at indices 0, 63, 64, -1, and -65, callback-fault rollback, and eight-worker exactly-one-clear-CF atomicity.
verification.negativeCoverage: The same standalone bytes at an adjacent RIP decline.

unmatchedPriorRunComparison.interpretation: The executions have different interrupt, compilation, trace, address-space, invalidation, and instruction totals. Absence of the measured site directly establishes bounded admission; aggregate and elapsed movements are reported for completeness and are not a performance claim.
